description: Native unofficial Spotify desktop player for Windows with synced lyrics, music videos and podcasts.
notes: Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. The release is not code-signed and may show SmartScreen on first run. Settings and login data are stored under %APPDATA%\Vinyl and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Vinyl, outside Scoop. The app has its own updater; use Scoop as the update authority.
